subject: The Registrar Bulletin: November edition
reason: Not triaged yet, so it's shown rather than hidden.
body_text:
Welcome to the November Registrar Bulletin!

Campus news: the library extends its hours for finals, and the new transit pass program launches in January. Meet our staff spotlight, Dana from transcripts.

Important: spring registration for continuing graduate students closes Friday, November 27 at 5pm. Students who are not registered by then lose their reserved seat in capstone sections.

Happy Thanksgiving from the Registrar team!
